title.narrative: Promoting youth led action and empowerment in Chile

description.narrative: This programme aims to expand and strengthen social and institutional capacities in Chile to design and implement inclusive and cross-sectoral policies and actions on youth, based on youth-generated evidence, while enhancing the capacities of youth-led organizations and youth meaningful engagement in policy dialogues and decision making processes. Within this, the programme particularly seeks to foster the meaningful engagement and effective participation of young women and young people within vulnerable and marginalized communities, as a means to establish mechanisms that favor inclusive development to build back better and leave no one behind. Through this support, the long-term goal is to contribute to fostering a culture of intergenerational dialogue, partnerships and work, within a framework of shared responsibilities and equality among government, youth and their constituencies, and all relevant stakeholders.
